name: ide-powershell
author: lumine-code
description: Provide PowerShell language features with Editor Services.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to Start-EditorServices.ps1 from a complete Editor Services distribution. Leave empty to use the managed copy or an installed module.

powershellPath.title: PowerShell Path
powershellPath.description: Absolute path to the supported PowerShell 7+ executable. Leave empty to find pwsh on PATH.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer managed installation when Editor Services cannot be found.

scriptAnalysis.title: Script Analysis
scriptAnalysis.description: Run the bundled PSScriptAnalyzer rules in addition to parser diagnostics.

analyzerSettingsPath.title: Analyzer Settings Path
analyzerSettingsPath.description: Optional PSScriptAnalyzer settings file, relative to the workspace root or absolute. Leave empty to use the default analyzer rules.

acceptRenameDisclaimer.title: Accept Rename Limitations
acceptRenameDisclaimer.description: Acknowledge Editor Services' documented best-effort, single-file rename limits. Otherwise the server asks once per session before renaming.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which PowerShell language features the editor uses. Rename is local and best effort; terminal, debugging and client code lenses are separate integrations.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete cmdlets, parameters, variables and members.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show command help and symbol information.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show command parameter sets while entering arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to function and variable definitions.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format scripts and selections with ScriptAnalyzer.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename local symbols within one script on a best-effort basis.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Classify PowerShell symbols with semantic information.
